text.en: Pet owners highlight the warm, attentive, and helpful support provided by both the veterinary surgeons and nursing staff. Clients appreciate that vets take ample time to answer questions and offer practical guidance for young pets. Overall feedback describes a welcoming practice that builds reassuring relationships with local families.

title.en: Gentle handling for dogs and cats

text.en: Reviewers note that companion animals are treated with genuine patience and gentle care during examinations. Dog owners mention that their pets feel relaxed and happy visiting the clinic for routine treatments. Clients also praise the considerate approach shown when examining anxious kittens and handling routine wellness checks.

Clients express satisfaction with the clinical thoroughness of routine examinations and treatment plans. Pet parents report that their animals returned home in good spirits and recovered well under the team's care. Farm owners and pet keepers alike value having dependable veterinary support available within the local community.

q.en: Does Millstreet Veterinary Group examine young kittens and puppies?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report bringing young kittens and dogs for thorough health exams, vaccinations, and initial guidance.

q.en: Are both farm animals and small pets treated at the clinic?

a.en: Yes, clients note that the veterinary group caters to agricultural livestock as well as family companion animals.

q.en: Can clients request emergency veterinary care out of hours?

a.en: Yes, the practice maintains 24-hour emergency on-call coverage for registered patients and urgent cases.

q.en: Is routine advice provided during consultations?

a.en: Reviewers highlight that veterinary surgeons provide clear tips on pet care, diet, and general maintenance during visits.
